id: title:Gilbert09:open sync method settings from the schemas table

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the SchemaTab UI in the Data Warehouse frontend, adding a clickable link to the configuration page and a tooltip distinguishing blocked states. This could help users discover and configure the sync method.
review.reason: Replaces a conditional rendering of the sync type label with a ternary expression, wrapping the result in a clickable link and a conditional tooltip. The previous implementation returned a plain span for missing sync_type and a warning-tag-only tooltip for blocked reasons. The new implementation always renders a tag, and the tag is wrapped in a link to the configuration page.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is inferred from the UI change; no runtime behavior, test results, or adoption metrics are supplied. The score is conservative, treating this as a localized maintenance and usability improvement rather than a systemic capability or risk reduction.
